metadata.description: AI CFO skills for founders, built for TOPY.AI: a senior CFO, accountant and bookkeeper on your own Stripe and QuickBooks. Core skills run on the TOPY CFO MCP server (https://topy.ai/mcp/cfo); QuickBooks' bank feed and rules are done in Chrome with the checks in each skill; standalone skills are finance methods that work anywhere.

plugins.name: topy-ai-cfo
plugins.description: TOPY AI CFO core: connects the TOPY CFO MCP server and runs the CFO day to day — Daily CFO brief, Connect the AI CFO, CFO goals, First set-up of the books.

plugins.name: topy-ai-cfo-bookkeeping
plugins.description: TOPY AI CFO Bookkeeping & close skills (4): Categorise transactions (UK), Journals and adjustments, Month-end close, Share capital. Add the topy-ai-cfo plugin too, for the core skills and the CFO MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-cfo-stripe
plugins.description: TOPY AI CFO Stripe service agent skills (3): Stripe's official MCP (money moves), Stripe revenue operations, Stripe into the books. Add the topy-ai-cfo plugin too, for the core skills and the CFO MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-cfo-quickbooks
plugins.description: TOPY AI CFO QuickBooks service agent skills (5): Match the bank feed (Chrome), Bank rules (Chrome), Lock a closed month, Reconcile a bank account, QuickBooks reports. Add the topy-ai-cfo plugin too, for the core skills and the CFO MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-cfo-reporting
plugins.description: TOPY AI CFO Reporting & runway skills (3): Finance reports for the c-levels, Management accounts, Runway and cash plan. Add the topy-ai-cfo plugin too, for the core skills and the CFO MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-cfo-compliance
plugins.description: TOPY AI CFO UK compliance skills (3): UK filing deadlines, VAT threshold watch, Year-end preparation. Add the topy-ai-cfo plugin too, for the core skills and the CFO MCP server.

plugins.name: topy-ai-cfo-all
plugins.description: All 22 TOPY AI CFO skills in one install: AI CFO core (MCP), Bookkeeping & close, Stripe service agent, QuickBooks service agent, Reporting & runway, UK compliance.
